claims.statement: IEA PVPS identifies technical due diligence, testing, monitoring, and analytics as important to PV project value and reliability.
The European Commission reported 56 GW of EU solar additions in 2025.

contrary_evidence: Sophisticated buyers already commission established technical advisers.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: accountants, O&M firms, lenders, and brokers.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 1000 assets plus 400 annual transactions yield 5-8 million PLN revenue and founder equity above 5 million PLN within six years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: 12-18 hours weekly with engineers paid per review.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: one completed packet repays acquisition.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: 3000-12000 PLN per transaction plus 100-300 PLN monthly custody.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: custody persists through ownership and portfolios transact repeatedly.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Transaction outcomes reveal which evidence predicts later performance
fingerprint.customer: Owners, buyers, and lenders of small commercial PV assets
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Tamper-evident evidence packets and normalized performance history
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: A transaction party pays at diligence and for custody
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An asset is refinanced, insured, or sold without trustworthy history

founder_fit: Financial analysis, telemetry modeling, and family-industry access align without public-brand dependence.
risks: Incomplete seller data could make a packet misleading.

structure.control_point: Chain-of-custody telemetry and documents linked to transaction and realized-performance outcomes
structure.critical_dependency: Seller-authorized data access and lender acceptance

thesis: An independent operating-history escrow lets buyers and lenders verify small commercial solar assets before financing or transfer.
title: SunLedger Exchange
uncertainties: Polish small-asset transfer volume and lender acceptance are unknown.
